collection_domain: all selected breakpoints/taps after explicit preparation; prior ROM execution intentionally unobserved except metadata/input transitions
temporal_domain: MAME machine-attotime and frame notifier count, event sequence monotonic; not GX frames
prepared_state: CPU bus byte FFF600=10 after frame1110; Start field digital active frame500..509; no other writes
limits: M68000 CURPC qualified as instruction start; raw PC includes prefetch
A7 maps to SP in MAME state interface
Memory taps report native16 aligned word address + mask; discarded lane data ignored
VDP CPU ports qualified, internal VRAM/CRAM/DMA not yet qualified
after_call breakpoint alone is not proof of return or call: no-call fixture reaches it without entry
stop: incomplete/loss/wrong identity/missing frozen args stops progression, original failures retained
